Added: First Unity expedition: one Reaver, three encounters, card rewards, final victory and defeat.
Touch card selection with explicit Play and enemy targeting.
Deterministic saved draw piles and channel-specific expedition saves.
Unity content import and owner-facing Web/Windows build commands.
Changed: Adapted existing Strike, Defend and Footwork definitions into reusable C# effect records.
Reused painted Reaver poses and original enemy/background art as pixel-identical PNG conversions.
Fixed: Replaced the default fixed-size Unity web canvas after phone testing exposed clipping.
Guarded repeated encounter starts and duplicate reward claims.
KnownIssues: Early vertical slice: full classes, equipment systems, branching maps and most original mechanics are not ported yet.
Native Android/iOS and physical phone performance have not been validated.
Animation currently uses a short pose swap; anchor-aware frame sequences and reduced-motion controls remain to implement.
Web builds currently compile locally. GitHub Actions validates packaged builds and publishes Pages; automatic Unity compilation requires runner/licensing setup.
WhatToTest: Start an expedition, enter combat, select and play cards, then end the turn.
Defeat an enemy, choose a card or healing reward, and continue to the boss.
Reload during combat and use Continue; check health, hand and encounter are restored.
Try the same flow in your phone browser and report your device, browser and build version.
